metadata.title: Prometheus AI Governance Component Definition
metadata.remarks: Component definition derived from Prometheus Governance Benchmark

components.title: Prometheus
components.description: AI/ML component for Prometheus with governance controls

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure every governed AI service has explicit Prometheus metric coverage

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Define and document the required Prometheus metrics, labels, scrape targets, and alerting scope for every governed AI service so observability expectations are explicit and reviewable.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed AI services with approved Prometheus metric coverage / total governed AI services in scope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure Prometheus metric coverage reaches 100% before a governed AI service is approved for production.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Prometheus is a monitoring and alerting system, so coverage of metrics and targets is its primary governance control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure scrape jobs, recording rules, and alerting rules are documented for governed AI workloads

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document scrape configs, service discovery assumptions, recording rules, alert rules, evaluation intervals, and retention assumptions for all governed AI observability workflows.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = governed observability workflows with complete scrape, rule, and retention documentation / total governed workflows.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure monitoring-configuration completeness reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Prometheus behavior is directly shaped by scrape config, rule evaluation, and retention choices, so documentation is required.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Missing scrape targets or failed collection

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure all governed targets are successfully scraped within the approved interval

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Monitor target health and scrape success so missing metrics, unreachable exporters, or configuration errors do not silently blind production monitoring.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Scrape success rate = successful scrapes / total scrape attempts; target availability = healthy targets / total governed targets.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure scrape success rate and target availability remain within the approved threshold for all governed targets.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Prometheus collects metrics from configured targets at intervals, so scrape reliability is one of the most direct platform-level controls.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed alerting rules achieve the required incident-detection coverage

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate critical alert rules against representative incident scenarios so operational failures in AI systems are detected within the approved detection window.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Incident-detection coverage, alert recall, mean time to detect

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Detection coverage = critical incidents correctly alerted / total tested critical incidents; alert recall computed over the approved incident suite; MTTD measured from incident start to firing alert.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure incident-detection coverage and alert recall remain above threshold for all governed critical alerts.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Prometheus evaluates rule expressions and triggers alerts, so alert detection quality is a primary operational-risk control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure alert precision remains above the approved threshold for governed alert policies

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Evaluate alert rules to reduce false positives and alert fatigue so AI operations teams can trust actionable Prometheus alerts.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Alert precision = true positive alerts / total fired alerts; false-positive rate = non-actionable alerts / total fired alerts over the observation window or test suite.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure alert precision remains above threshold and false-positive rate remains below threshold for governed alert policies.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Prometheus alerts are only useful when they are actionable; excessive false positives degrade incident response in AI operations.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Incorrect PromQL queries or recording rules

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed PromQL queries and recording rules are validated against approved expected results

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate critical PromQL expressions and recording rules against reference datasets or known-good scenarios so dashboards and alerts are not driven by incorrect calculations.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Query correctness rate, recording-rule correctness rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Correctness rate = critical queries or recording rules producing approved expected outputs / total governed query or rule tests.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure PromQL and recording-rule correctness remains above threshold for governed operational logic.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: PromQL and recording rules are core Prometheus features, so query correctness is a direct platform control for AI observability.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: High query latency in monitoring workflows

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure critical Prometheus queries meet the approved latency objective

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Benchmark critical dashboard, alert, and SLO queries so observability workflows do not become unusably slow under production-scale AI workloads.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: p95 query latency, mean query latency

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Measure PromQL execution times for governed queries and compute p95 and mean latency under the approved workload profile.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure critical Prometheus query latency remains within the approved service objective.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Prometheus query performance matters for real-time AI operations, especially where alerting and dashboards rely on complex PromQL expressions.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure time-series retention and cardinality remain within the approved storage budget

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate retention periods, sample volume, and label-cardinality growth so Prometheus storage does not degrade or exceed approved operational limits.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Retention compliance rate, TSDB growth rate, label-cardinality growth

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Retention compliance = governed deployments meeting approved retention policy / total governed deployments; growth rates computed from sample ingestion, block growth, and cardinality trends.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure retention and TSDB growth remain within the approved storage and performance budget.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Prometheus uses a local time-series database, so retention and cardinality management are essential for sustainable AI observability.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Label explosion and unbounded metric cardinality

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed metrics follow approved label-cardinality policies

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Review and enforce label usage so governed AI metrics do not create unbounded cardinality from user IDs, prompts, request IDs, or other high-cardinality dimensions.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Cardinality-policy compliance rate, high-cardinality metric count

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compliance rate = governed metrics satisfying approved label-cardinality policy / total governed metrics; high-cardinality metric count from the approved observation window.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure label-cardinality policy compliance reaches 100% and high-cardinality violations remain below threshold for governed metrics.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Prometheus multidimensional label model is powerful but vulnerable to cardinality explosions if not governed.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Sensitive data in metric labels or values

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure Prometheus metrics do not expose PII or confidential values in labels or samples

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate governed metric names, labels, and values so personal data, prompts, tokens, or other confidential information are not emitted into Prometheus telemetry.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Exposure rate = metric samples or labels containing unauthorized sensitive data / total governed metric samples tested; compute precision and recall where detection logic is used.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure sensitive metric exposure remains below threshold and privacy-detection recall remains above threshold before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Prometheus data can leak sensitive information if labels or metric values are not designed carefully, especially for AI prompts and user metadata.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure only approved metric endpoints and scrape paths are exposed to Prometheus

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Restrict metric exposure so only approved exporters and service endpoints are scraped, and so internal AI observability data is not unintentionally exposed beyond approved boundaries.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed services exposing only approved metric endpoints and scrape paths / total governed services in scope.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure approved metric-endpoint coverage reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Prometheus relies on HTTP pull collection, so endpoint governance is a direct security and exposure control.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Missed transient spikes due to poor interval configuration

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure scrape and evaluation intervals meet the approved detection objectives for governed AI signals

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate scrape intervals and rule evaluation intervals so transient latency spikes, error bursts, and autoscaling events in AI systems are observable within the approved detection window.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compliance rate = governed metrics and rules meeting the approved observation and alerting window / total governed metrics and rules tested.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure governed scrape and evaluation intervals satisfy the approved detection objective for critical AI signals.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Prometheus interval-based design means poorly chosen scrape or evaluation intervals can create real blind spots in AI operations.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed AI services publish the SLIs required for approved SLOs

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Define and validate the Prometheus metrics needed to compute critical SLIs for latency, error rate, throughput, availability, and safety-sensitive service health.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed SLOs with required underlying Prometheus metrics available / total governed SLOs.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure SLI coverage reaches 100% before production approval of governed AI services.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Prometheus is commonly the source of truth for SLI and SLO calculations, so SLI coverage is a strong enterprise control.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure federation or hierarchical monitoring preserves governed AI metrics end to end

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate hierarchical federation or multi-tier Prometheus designs so critical AI service metrics are not dropped, relabeled incorrectly, or delayed beyond policy limits.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Federation completeness = governed metrics preserved end to end across tiers / total governed metrics expected in downstream Prometheus systems; metric-loss rate = missing federated metrics / total governed metrics.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure federation completeness remains above threshold and metric-loss rate remains below threshold for governed hierarchies.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Prometheus supports hierarchical and horizontal federation, so multi-tier observability correctness is a real platform concern for enterprise AI systems.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed dashboards and graphs expose the metrics needed for incident triage

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Provide dashboards, graphs, and query views that expose the critical operational metrics needed to understand AI service degradation, scaling problems, and alert triggers.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed AI services with approved dashboards or graphing views for critical metrics / total governed AI services.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure dashboard coverage reaches 100% for governed AI services.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Prometheus itself provides graphing support, and in practice its data powers triage views that make incidents understandable.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure subgroup-sensitive service metrics are available where fairness monitoring is required

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Where policy requires fairness monitoring, publish Prometheus metrics that let teams observe subgroup disparities in model quality or service outcomes over time.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Fairness-observability coverage, subgroup disparity metric availability

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed fairness-sensitive services with required subgroup metrics available / total governed fairness-sensitive services.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure subgroup-sensitive observability coverage reaches 100% where fairness monitoring is required.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Prometheus does not compute fairness by itself, but it is often the runtime observability layer where fairness-related service metrics must surface.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Missing safety telemetry for governed AI services

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed AI services export the safety metrics required for runtime monitoring

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Where policy requires runtime safety monitoring, publish Prometheus metrics for toxicity incidents, policy violations, refusals, or safety-trigger events from governed AI services.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed AI services requiring runtime safety observability with required Prometheus safety metrics available / total governed safety-sensitive services.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure runtime safety-metric coverage reaches 100% for all governed safety-sensitive AI services.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Prometheus is often the place where safety events become operationally visible, even if the safety logic lives elsewhere.

props.name: Sub_Risk
props.value: Undetected rollout regressions in AI services

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure rollout health metrics are monitored for governed AI releases

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Monitor deployment, pod, and endpoint health metrics during governed AI rollouts so regressions are visible before they become widespread incidents.

props.name: Associated_Metric
props.value: Rollout health coverage, rollout incident detection rate

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed rollouts with required Prometheus health telemetry available / total governed rollouts; detection rate = rollout incidents correctly surfaced / total tested rollout incidents.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure rollout health coverage and rollout incident detection remain above threshold for governed AI releases.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Prometheus is commonly the first layer used to watch rollout regressions in production AI services and infrastructure.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure Prometheus captures the metrics required for autoscaling and capacity alerts

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Validate that governed AI services expose the metrics needed for autoscaling logic and capacity alerting so scale failures are not caused by missing telemetry.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = governed AI services with required autoscaling or capacity metrics available in Prometheus / total governed AI services requiring those metrics.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure autoscaling-signal coverage reaches 100% for all governed services that rely on metric-based scaling or capacity alerts.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Prometheus often feeds autoscaling decisions indirectly through external systems, so missing metrics can create real service-risk blind spots.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed Prometheus deployments meet approved resilience architecture requirements

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Use the approved Prometheus topology, backup, and failover design so loss of a single monitoring node does not create unacceptable observability gaps for critical AI systems.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Compliance rate = governed Prometheus deployments meeting the approved resilience architecture / total governed Prometheus deployments.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure monitoring-resilience compliance reaches 100% for deployments observing critical AI systems.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: The Prometheus README notes that single server nodes are autonomous and do not depend on distributed storage, so resilience architecture must be designed deliberately where coverage is critical.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed Prometheus deployments cover scrape, query, alerting, retention, privacy, and resilience tests

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Build a Prometheus release standard that requires representative testing across target scraping, PromQL correctness, alert quality, cardinality, retention, privacy, and topology resilience domains.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Coverage = number of mandated Prometheus risk domains with active tracked evidence / total mandated risk domains in the release standard.

props.name: HF_Metric
props.value: Composite evaluation coverage based on benchmark families

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure risk-test coverage remains at or above threshold across the required Prometheus validation domains.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Prometheus is a monitoring substrate, so release readiness must focus on observability correctness, alert quality, and operational sustainability.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure governed AI services document which metrics and alerts represent their operational state

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document the metric names, SLO signals, alert rules, dashboards, and escalation assumptions that represent the health of each governed AI service in Prometheus.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = governed AI services with completed observability transparency fields / total governed AI services.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure service observability transparency completeness reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Prometheus governance is strongest when teams can clearly explain which metrics and alerts represent service health and why.

props.name: Rule_Title
props.value: Ensure Prometheus topology, retention, federation, and alerting assumptions are documented for governed environments

props.name: Rule_Description
props.value: Document Prometheus deployment topology, scrape strategy, retention policy, federation design, rule evaluation assumptions, and alert routing scope for each governed environment.

props.name: Metric_Calculation
props.value: Completeness = completed required architecture and monitoring-workflow fields / total required fields in the approved transparency checklist.

props.name: Metric_Based_Rule
props.value: Ensure system transparency completeness reaches 100% before production approval.

props.name: Mapping_Notes
props.value: Prometheus behavior is shaped by topology, retention, and rule design, so environment-level transparency is essential for enterprise reviewability.
